Nora V: Quick digest from the 6mo recurrence scan. Three high-impact repeaters and two quick wins. Dropping owners so we can convert to tracked tickets.

Nora V: Top items: 1) cold KV cache spikes -> warming job + TTL audit. 2) autoscale stalls on sharp bursts -> cooldown tweak + tiny burst pool. 3) deploy config skew (missing secrets/flags) -> env-diff gate. Quick wins: add warm smoke check and add env-diff alerting.

Sam K: I can take #2 (autoscale). Will spike cooldown tuning + add autoscale_miss_rate dashboard. ETA 7 business days.

Diego M: I'll take #1 (warming). Plan: warming job + smoke check. ETA 6 business days.

Lina H: I'll own #3 (env-diff gate). Small PR to pipeline + unit tests. ETA 3 business days.

incident-bot: Created tickets: INC-2500 (cache-warm), INC-2501 (autoscale-burst), INC-2502 (env-diff-gate).

Sam K: ACK INC-2501. I'll post a tuning doc and cost ask for the burst pool to INC-2501.

Diego M: ACK INC-2500. WIP snippet for warming: `curl -X POST https://internal/warm -d '{"model":"r-prod","top_k":50}'` then run a small sample inference.

Lina H: ACK INC-2502. Will add a gating check and an alert threshold for diffs > 2 keys.

Nora V: Thanks all. I'll follow up in two weeks with a status snapshot on the board. If blockers appear, add notes to tickets and ping me. Expect ~30% recurrence reduction from these fixes per the analysis. :thumbsup:
